draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.23, the 78th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 13th of 37 at CB. He went 76th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Sean Murphy-Bunting. Testing standouts: three-cone (87th percentile). College production: 10 passes defended in 2019, 4th of 36 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 6 pro, currently with the New York Giants (reserve). 64 career games and 63 starts over 5 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Trending down from his peak: 4 AV in 2025 against a career-best 7 in 2023. Strengths in 2025: missed tackle rate 5.2% (83rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-5 cornerback who played: 68.1% season snap share against a median of 33.5%, above the norm.
